indeterminate.finding: The non-dict parent branch of classify_inbound_parent (an unreadable parent value that must NOT be treated as 'no parent') is never exercised by any test. classify_inbound_parent is not called directly by any test, and the diffing suite only feeds it None, truthy strings, and {'key': <bound/unbound>} shapes via the differ — never a non-dict parent (e.g. a bare string or list). A regression collapsing this branch into PARENT_NO_PARENT would emit a data-destroying inbound clear on an unreadable value, and no test would go red.

No test drives a malformed non-empty parent dict lacking a usable key, so a regression classifying it as PARENT_NO_PARENT would emit a spurious clear undetected.
scenarios: Jira returns parent in a non-{'key':...} REST shape (e.g. a string or list); a refactor mis-classifies it as PARENT_NO_PARENT and clears a managed local parent
